message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a light-colored pickup truck positioned horizontally in the center. A man with a dark beard, wearing a black shirt and a dark cap, is visible through the driver-side window, holding a small object in one hand. Atop the truck’s cab and wooden-slatted flatbed stands a large, orange, four-legged animal resembling a bull or cow. This animal holds a long, thin stick in its mouth, extending forward. A piece of paper currency dangles from the end of a thin line attached to the stick.

The background consists of light-blue and white horizontal bands suggesting a sky with stylized clouds and a flat, pale landscape. The magazine's masthead "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the animal. Top text reads "MODUS SUAP UNTUK EMIRSYAH SATAR" and "KEPALA DAERAH TERBAIK 2016". Bold black text at the bottom right reads "TERALIS UNTUK PATRIALIS," followed by smaller text: "HAKIM MAHKAMAH KONSTITUSI INI DIDUGA MEMAINKAN PUTUSAN SEPUTAR IMPOR DAGING DI UNDANG-UNDANG PETERNAKAN. MELIBATKAN PEMAIN LAMA." A barcode and date "31 JANUARI - 5 FEBRUARI 2017" are at the bottom left.
